datum: Give peace, O Lord, * in our time, because there is none other that fighteth for us, but only Thou, O our God.
V. Peace be within thy walls.
R. And prosperity within thy palaces.

O God, from Whom all holy desires, all good counsels, and all just works do proceed; give unto Thy servants that peace which the world cannot give, that both our hearts may be set to obey Thy commandments, and also that by Thee we being defended from the fear of our enemies, may pass our time in rest and quietness.
